php2shell.reason: Target menunjukkan anomali memory crash / vulnerable
php2shell.evidence: [VULNERABLE] http://localhost/proj-php2shell/ - Status: 200 - SAPI: mod_php/PHP-FPM - Verdict: VULNERABLE

findings.title: Unencrypted HTTP Connection
findings.desc: Situs melayani trafik tanpa enkripsi HTTPS. Data kredensial dan sesi perkara dapat disadap.
findings.remediation: Pasang sertifikat TLS/SSL (misal Let's Encrypt) dan lakukan redirect 301 dari HTTP ke HTTPS.

findings.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP)
findings.desc: Header Content-Security-Policy tidak terpasang. CSP sangat efektif meredam serangan XSS dan data injection.
findings.remediation: Terapkan minimal: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none';

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
findings.desc: Header X-Frame-Options tidak aktif, memungkinkan halaman SIPP di-embed ke dalam iframe situs jahat (Clickjacking).

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options (nosniff)
findings.desc: Browser dapat melakukan MIME-sniffing terhadap berkas unggahan, membuka celah eksekusi skrip.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.desc: URL lengkap beserta parameter sensitif dapat bocor ke situs eksternal saat navigasi keluar.

findings.title: Information Disclosure: X-Powered-By Exposed
findings.desc: Header membocorkan versi teknologi: "PHP/8.3.30". Ini mempermudah penyerang memetakan sasaran PHP2Shell.
findings.remediation: Di php.ini, ubah parameter: expose_php = Off

findings.title: Information Disclosure: Detailed Server Version in Header
findings.desc: Header Server membocorkan versi spesifik perangkat lunak: "Apache/2.4.66 (Win64) OpenSSL/3.0.18 PHP/8.3.30".
findings.remediation: Apache: ServerTokens Prod, ServerSignature Off. Nginx: server_tokens off;

findings.title: Dangerous HTTP Method Allowed: TRACE (Cross-Site Tracing)
findings.desc: Metode HTTP TRACE aktif di web server. Hal ini memungkinkan penyerang mencuri kredensial cookie HttpOnly melalui teknik XST.
findings.remediation: Apache: TraceEnable Off. Nginx: Batasi metode hanya GET, POST, HEAD.
